svg.title: Process-aware anomaly detection with multi-agent AI
svg.desc: Six landscape panels show Olist data preparation, process analysis, detector development, historical event replay, three evidence-constrained AI agents, and local BI decision support. Scores and explanations are separate. Causes remain unconfirmed.
